verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I can see the lightning
I can feel the thunder
I can hear the voices
Proceeding from Your throne

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
Only one word comes to mind
There's only one word to describe

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Holy, holy
Lord God Almighty
Holy, holy
Lord God Almighty

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Twenty-four elders bowing low
Casting down their crowns of gold
Four living creatures crying out
Day and night, night and day

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
There is no one like You
You are holy, holy
There is no one like You
You are holy, holy

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
There is no one like You
You are worthy, worthy

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Holy, holy
Is the Lord God Almighty
Holy, holy
Is the Lord God Almighty
